classification_description: Useful relationship exists, but varies materially across blocks/streets or holdout weakens.

product_recommendations.q1_can_known_bc_act_as_anchor: YES. Real parcel assignment demonstrates high ordinal alignment (median |rho| = 0.88). Anchors provide highly localized search seeds.
product_recommendations.q4_comparison_with_legacy_001_080: Reduces candidates from 80 down to 47 (approximately 1.7x reduction) while capturing 90.6% of local target parcels. At W=3, real anchor lift vs random same-DSQ window is 1.51x, whereas at W=23, real anchor lift is approximately 1.01x. Therefore, LLL position carries meaningful discriminatory information at tight local windows, while most high-recall performance at wide windows comes from broad DSQ coverage.
product_recommendations.q5_is_compression_sufficient_for_generat: NO as a standalone candidate generator. A 1.7x reduction (80 -> 47) at W=23 is insufficient to serve as a standalone candidate generator for Facade Checker, because at wide windows discriminatory lift over a random same-DSQ window is negligible (1.01x). However, at tight windows (W=1..5, lift 1.32x..1.51x), DELTA_LLL provides strong local discriminatory value.
product_recommendations.q6_next_phase_recommendation: Do NOT use +/-23 as a standalone candidate generator for Facade Checker. Recommend using DELTA_LLL as one ranking feature in a multi-signal candidate ranker, followed by a blinded real-listing experiment.
